description: This header file defines an API for programmatically building JSON data structures in C using a 'json_writer' object that manages an internal string buffer. It includes functions for initiating JSON objects and arrays, appending various data types as fields or array elements, nesting objects/arrays, and finalizing the JSON structure. The file serves as an interface for a JSON-writing utility designed for generating JSON strings in a compact form without parsing or manipulating existing JSON data.

methods.name: jw_init
methods.description: Initializes a json_writer structure by setting up internal buffers for JSON data and open stack.

methods.name: jw_release
methods.description: Releases and cleans up resources associated with a json_writer.

methods.name: jw_object_begin
methods.description: Starts a JSON object as the top-level structure, with optional pretty-printing.

methods.name: jw_array_begin
methods.description: Starts a JSON array as the top-level structure, with optional pretty-printing.

methods.name: jw_object_string
methods.description: Adds a string key-value pair to the current JSON object.

methods.name: jw_object_intmax
methods.description: Adds an integer key-value pair to the current JSON object.

methods.name: jw_object_double
methods.description: Adds a double-precision floating point key-value pair with specified precision to the current object.

methods.name: jw_object_true
methods.description: Adds a boolean true field to the current object.

methods.name: jw_object_false
methods.description: Adds a boolean false field to the current object.

methods.name: jw_object_bool
methods.description: Adds a boolean field with a specified true/false value to the current object.

methods.name: jw_object_null
methods.description: Adds a null field to the current object.

methods.name: jw_object_sub_jw
methods.description: Embeds another json_writer's JSON content as a field value in the current object.

methods.name: jw_object_inline_begin_object
methods.description: Starts a nested object inline as a field value within the current object.

methods.name: jw_object_inline_begin_array
methods.description: Starts a nested array inline as a field value within the current object.

methods.name: jw_array_string
methods.description: Appends a string value to the current array.

methods.name: jw_array_intmax
methods.description: Appends an integer value to the current array.

methods.name: jw_array_double
methods.description: Appends a double value to the current array with specified precision.

methods.name: jw_array_true
methods.description: Appends a boolean true value to the current array.

methods.name: jw_array_false
methods.description: Appends a boolean false value to the current array.

methods.name: jw_array_bool
methods.description: Appends a boolean value with specified true/false to the current array.

methods.name: jw_array_null
methods.description: Appends a null value to the current array.

methods.name: jw_array_sub_jw
methods.description: Appends another json_writer's JSON content as a value in the current array.

methods.name: jw_array_argc_argv
methods.description: Appends a specified number of string arguments from argc/argv to the current array.

methods.name: jw_array_argv
methods.description: Appends a null-terminated array of strings to the current array.

methods.name: jw_array_inline_begin_object
methods.description: Starts a nested object inline as a value in the current array.

methods.name: jw_array_inline_begin_array
methods.description: Starts a nested array inline as a value in the current array.

methods.name: jw_is_terminated
methods.description: Checks whether the current JSON object or array has been properly closed.

methods.name: jw_end
methods.description: Terminates the current open JSON object or array.
